text: Enflame shares rose 206% on their Shanghai debut after retail orders exceeded available shares by over 6,000 times. The unprofitable chipmaker reported 990M yuan in 2025 revenue and joins MetaX, Moore Threads and Biren as publicly traded Chinese AI-chip firms.

meta.note: Market demand and operating performance remain distinct structural coordinates.

text: U.S. diesel averaged $6.06 per gallon, 63% above year-ago levels, with California at $7.98. About 5M bpd of global refinery capacity is offline, U.S. refineries are at 98% utilization, and fuel transit through Hormuz remains constrained.

meta.note: Supply constraints span refining capacity and transit infrastructure across multiple regions.

text: August CPI rose 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y, while core rose 0.3% m/m and 2.4% y/y. Energy increased 2.1% monthly and 16.3% annually, with gasoline up 27.4% y/y and fuel oil 52%. Shelter rose 0.3%.

meta.note: Headline and core inflation remain separated by elevated energy-price pressure.

text: CDC declared the largest U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak over after 12,833 cases across 21 states and two deaths. The cluster was linked to Taylor Farms shredded iceburg lettuce from Mexico amid 19,595 total U.S. cases during the season.

meta.note: Governance is the closest canonical channel for a public-health surveillance and outbreak-closure event.

text: Saudi Arabia shut its 7M-bpd East-West crude pipeline after attacks in the Riyadh and Madinah regions. The route links production to Red Sea terminals and operates outside the Strait of Hormuz. Damage to the pipeline remains unspecified.

meta.note: The shutdown is precautionary; the pipeline's physical damage and duration of unavailability remain unspecified.
